editorial:
Ever have one of those mornings where everything just goes wrong? That is exactly where you land with Dreux and Alyssa. These two are best friends and roommates who just want to keep their lives together, but things spiral fast when they realize Alyssa's boyfriend spent their rent money. Now, they are stuck in a wild race against the clock to find the cash before they get kicked out of their home. The vibe is light, chaotic, and feels like those stressful but funny days you have shared with your own closest friends. It is a relatable ride that keeps you laughing at the absurdity of their bad luck.

The chemistry between the leads is what really makes the movie work, as their bickering feels totally natural. The pacing is quick, so you never feel bored, though some of the plot twists are a bit predictable. If you are looking for a low-stress movie for a Friday night, this is it. It is a great pick for a group hang where you just want to turn your brain off and enjoy some laughs.
endingExplained: After a series of crazy mishaps, Dreux and Alyssa finally track down the boyfriend and force him to pay back every cent. They slide the money to their landlord just seconds before the eviction notice is served. In the final scene, Alyssa dumps her boyfriend for good and decides to find a more reliable roommate. The movie ends with the two friends celebrating their victory with a huge party in the apartment they almost lost.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves chaotic comedies and stories about best friends.
